# Starship Prompt Builder

> A private, browser-based visual editor for Starship prompt configuration. It previews simulated shell states and exports ordinary starship.toml.

- [Builder](https://starship.ndl.au/): Edit, preview, import, share, and export a Starship prompt.
- [Guides](https://starship.ndl.au/guides/): Practical guidance for generating, importing, formatting, styling, and extending a config.
- [Module reference](https://starship.ndl.au/modules/): Curated examples, options, variables, and common adjustments for frequently used modules.
- [Source](https://github.com/nicklambourne/starship-prompt-builder): MIT-licensed source and issue tracker.
- [Official Starship documentation](https://starship.rs/config/): Canonical upstream configuration reference.
